title: Server: seat selection — player picks seat on join
description: Extend the Hello handshake to include an optional preferred_seat field. If specified and available, player gets that seat. If taken, reject with error listing available seats. If omitted, auto-assign as today (backward compatible). Update join_room to check seat availability before assignment. Enables players to choose sides (e.g., Blue/Red in wargame, East/West in Bridge). Spectator seat still auto-assigned for overflow.
close_reason: preferred_seat field on Hello. Validates seat exists and is available, returns invalid_seat/seat_taken errors. Falls back to auto-assign if omitted.
